title: fix(plugin-form,fields): a superseded load or save commits nothing in the line-items panel; `useRecordQuery` resets when it can no longer query (objectui#10712)
body:
Fixes #10712

Clause-②: no

PR 2 of 2 for objectui#10712. PR objectui#10723 (merged `4345558`, `Refs #10712`) carried the six record forms and `useRecordQuery`'s `runQuery`. This PR carries the six rows seat 5's release note `5852404775` listed for PR 2: `LineItemsPanel`'s load and save (R1–R2), its dirty-reload hold (R3, per the seat's ruling `5855609171`, option A, in round 2), and `useRecordQuery`'s reset and debounce (R4–R6, with R6's sort / page sibling, found by the round-2 contract review `5856013809`, fixed in round 3). No export, prop, schema key or registration moves; `@object-ui/plugin-form` and `@object-ui/fields` publish the same surface. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN` (`mode:subagent`), executing triage `5839162848`, release note `5852404775` and ruling `5855609171`.

## What changed

- **`packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`** (+120 / −8 against base `25c7d584e4`; round 2 added +76 / −4).
  - **R1.** The load's rows commit (`setRows` / `setOriginal` / `setDirty` / `setRowsHeldFor`) sits behind `if (!isCurrent()) return;`, taken right after the awaited `find`, and the `finally` releases `loading` only for the current run (`if (isCurrent()) setLoading(false)`). The `setError(null)` after the commit keeps its rule (cleared on a commit, objectui#10682) and no longer needs its own `isCurrent()`.
  - **R2.** The save takes the parent it saves (`savedParent`) and a `parentStillShown()` predicate read from `latestLoadRef` (the panel's latest `load` and `parentId`, written from an effect keyed on both, never during render); after the batch it reloads through `latestLoadRef.current.load('save')` only while that parent is still on screen, and writes its failure only then. `save`'s dependency list drops `load`, which it no longer reads.
  - **R3 (round 2).** `load` takes an `origin` (`'inputs'` from the fetch effect, `'save'` from the post-save reload, the default). An `'inputs'` read is HELD when the panel holds unsaved edits for the CURRENT parent: `dirty`, the rows held for `parentId`, and the last run's parent, adapter, child object and relationship field equal to the current ones. A held read is not numbered (it supersedes nothing) and sets `heldReloadRef`; every run that does start clears that flag, since every run reads the panel's current inputs. A same-parent read that was in flight at the hold replays it once on its commit through a `heldReplay` state bump the fetch effect is keyed on (the panel is clean after that commit, so the replay is not held). The values `load` reads to decide this live in refs, so an edit does not move `load`: `heldEditsRef` mirrors `dirty` / `rowsHeldFor` from an effect declared ahead of `load`; `lastRunRef` is written where a run is numbered. The precedent is the default form's bus hold, `formDirtyRef` / `heldChangeRef` in `ObjectForm.tsx` (unsaved input holds the re-read; one is replayed when the form is pristine again or its save lands), named in the comment.
  - The ruling's condition is the three-clause one (`dirty`, `rowsHeldFor` equals `parentId`, the last run's parent equals `parentId`). The adapter / child object / relationship-field identity is added to it so the hold covers exactly the inputs the ruling names (sort, limit, filter): rows loaded from another adapter or another object are not the same rows, so a change of either is read. Pinned as controls.
  - Every decline in `load` still releases `loading` before any await, so a declining run is never superseded at the `finally`.
- **`packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.ts`** (+52 / −30 against base; round 3 added +13 / −7). One `reset` callback (the consumer's `reset()` and the reset effect's body) bumps `runSeqRef`, clears the debounce timer, ends `loading`, and clears the query state. The reset effect is keyed on `canQuery` (`enabled` AND a data source with `find` AND an object name) instead of `enabled`. A `clearDebounce` callback replaces the three inline `clearTimeout` spellings. The debounce cleanup effect (formerly unmount only) is keyed on what the fetch effect is keyed on: `runQuery` (moved by `enabled`, the data source, the object, `pageSize`, `paginate`, the filter, `expand` and `searchFields`) and, since round 3, `page` and `sort`, which move without moving `runQuery`. So a pending debounced search is dropped whenever the fetch effect is about to run a query with the typed term, and on unmount. The header bullet about clearing is reworded.
  - **Round 3, the R6 sibling.** Keyed on `runQuery` alone (round 2), the cleanup let a `setSearch` timer armed before a `toggleSort` / `setSort` or `setPage` inside the window stay live: `setSearch` arms it with page 1 and the sort in scope, the fetch effect ran the query with the new sort or page and the typed term, and the timer then ran as the latest call with the older sort or page, so its answer won. The reviewer offered two fixes: `clearDebounce()` at the top of the fetch effect body, or `page` and `sort` in the existing cleanup's key. The second is one dependency-list edit on the effect that already exists and already covers unmount, so it is the fix. `refetch()` is not a clearing point (source reading, not pinned): called in the same event as a `setSearch`, its closure still holds the previous term, so dropping the armed timer there would drop the typed one.
- **Dependency lists that move, stated in full**: in the panel, `save` drops `load` (it reads `latestLoadRef`), the `latestLoadRef` effect is keyed `[load, parentId]`, the `heldEditsRef` mirror effect `[dirty, rowsHeldFor]`, and the fetch effect goes from `[load]` to `[load, heldReplay]`; `load`'s own list is unchanged. In the hook, the reset effect goes from `[enabled]` to `[canQuery, reset]`, the debounce cleanup effect from `[]` to `[runQuery, page, sort, clearDebounce]` (round 2 had `[runQuery, clearDebounce]`), `setSearch` gains `clearDebounce`, and the two new callbacks are keyed `[]` (`clearDebounce`) and `[clearDebounce]` (`reset`). The hook's fetch effect (`[canQuery, page, sort, runQuery]`) and `runQuery` are unchanged.
- **Pins**: `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.supersededRun-10712.test.tsx` (10 rows, R1–R2), `packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.dirtyReloadHold-10712.test.tsx` (14 rows, R3, round 2), `packages/fields/src/widgets/useRecordQuery.cannotQuery-10712.test.tsx` (12 rows, R4–R6: 10 in round 1, the sort-in-window and page-in-window rows in round 3, whose header now names both triggers).
- **One merged pin edited (round 2, per the ruling): `LineItemsPanel.heldForAnotherParent-10740.test.tsx`**, the row "a RE-load of the SAME parent that fails keeps the held edits: the edited line is drawn editable, Save is on, and the save carries l1 under p1". Exactly what changed: its TRIGGER. It re-read `p1` through a host re-render with `limit: 200` while `p1`'s edit was held; under the hold that re-render issues no read, so the row would have waited forever for its second `find`. It now presses Save, lands the batch, and fails the post-save reload (the second `find`, still `p1`'s). Every assertion is unchanged: the edited line drawn, inputs enabled, no placeholder, Save on, and the save (now the row's second save) carrying `update l1 { label: 'p1 line edited', po: 'p1' }`. The property it keeps — a same-parent re-read that fails leaves the author's lines drawn, editable and saveable under that parent — is the same, exercised through the one same-parent re-read that still runs while edits are held. The row's comment and the pin header's bullet say so. The other eight rows are byte-identical and green.
- **One round-1 pin row rewritten (round 2)**: `supersededRun-10712`'s "the reload after a save reads the panel's CURRENT inputs, not the ones captured at the click" re-rendered with `limit: 200` while the save was in flight and expected an immediate second `find`; under the hold it now asserts no read is issued for the change (`find` still 1), and that the post-save reload (now the second `find`) carries `$top: 200`. Ablation A5 (the captured `load`) still reddens it.
- **Two `patch` changesets**, one per package, no new changeset in round 3. The plugin-form one gained an R3 paragraph in round 2; its frontmatter is byte-identical. The fields one is unchanged since round 1: its closing sentence 「Now a pending debounced search is dropped when the query changes.」, which the round-2 review measured false at `bef026bdc5` for a sort or page change, is now true for every input `runQuery` reads plus `page` and `sort` (pinned for filter, sort and page; the other inputs move `runQuery` the same way the filter does).

## The six rows, measured first

Every measurement is the new pin run on the UNTOUCHED base sources (`25c7d584e4` for R1–R2 and R4–R6; the round-1 head `5cd02243bb` for R3), before the source edit, through the real `SchemaRenderer` and `record:line_items` (panel) or `renderHook` (hook), every `find` and `batchTransaction` a deferred promise settled by hand.

| row | measurement on base | change |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **R1** load: rows commit and `loading` scoped to the run | TRUE. `p1`'s read held, host moves to `p2`, `p2` answers `p2 line`, then `p1` answers late: drawn lines `[]` (the superseded rows were committed, then refused as `p1`'s behind the objectui#10740 placeholder; `p2`'s answer gone either way). Superseded read landing FIRST as a failure: loading paragraph gone and the grid drawn while `p2`'s read was pending; landing first as a success: loading gone, placeholder drawn. | the rows commit and the `finally` read `isCurrent()` |
| **R2a** save reloads the OLD parent | TRUE. `p1` edited, Save (batch held), host moves to `p2`, `p2` answers; the batch lands: a THIRD `find` with `po: 'p1'` (`find` called 3 times, expected 2), and the save never ends. With `p2`'s load having FAILED instead: the same third read, whose commit would clear `p2`'s own failure banner. | the reload runs only while `savedParent` is on screen, through the panel's latest `load` |
| **R2b** save failure written after a move | TRUE. Same sequence, the batch rejects `p1 save failed`: the banner is drawn over `p2`'s panel. | the failure is written only while `savedParent` is on screen |
| **R2c** save reloads with the inputs captured at the click | TRUE. Save on `p1` (batch held), host re-renders with `limit: 200`; the batch lands: the save's reload carries `$top: 500`, the click's row cap. | `latestLoadRef.current.load('save')` |
| **R3** a sort / limit / filter change while rows are dirty discards the edits | TRUE on all three triggers (round-1 probe, then the round-2 pin on `5cd02243bb`): before, drawn `['p1 line edited']`, Save on, 1 `find`; the re-render issues a second `find` for `p1` (with `$orderby`, `$top: 200`, or the AND-merged filter) and the grid is replaced by the loading paragraph; after the answer, drawn `['p1 line']`, Save off, no banner. Silent. | the hold (round 2) |
| **R4** `enabled` goes false with a read in flight | TRUE. After the disable: `records` `[]`, `loading` TRUE; the late answer then commits: `records` `['late']`, `loading` false. `reset()` behaves the same. | the reset bumps `runSeqRef` and ends `loading` |
| **R5** `objectName` / `dataSource` going null | TRUE. `objectName` to null after `first` committed and a `refetch` in flight: `records` stay `['first']`, `loading` stays TRUE, then `['late']` commits. `dataSource` to null with a read in flight: `loading` stays TRUE, the answer commits. | the reset effect is keyed on `canQuery` |
| **R6** the debounced `setSearch` closure | TRUE. `setSearch('a')`, then a filter change inside the window: the fetch effect issues the current query (`$filter closed`, `$search 'a'`), and the timer then issues a THIRD query from the older closure (`find` called 3 times). `enabled` going false inside the window: the pending search still ran. **Sibling, found by the round-2 review, re-measured on `bef026bdc5` by the round-3 base leg and StrictMode probe:** `setSearch('a')` then `toggleSort('name')` inside the window: the fetch effect's call carries `$orderby name asc` and `$search a`, and the timer then issues a THIRD call with `$search a` and no `$orderby`; with `paginate`, `setSearch('a')` then `setPage(2)`: the second call carries `$skip 10`, the third `$skip 0`. Answered last, the third wins (the review's reading: records `UNSORTED` while `sort` reads `name asc`, `PAGE1` while `page` reads 2). | the debounce is cleared where `runQuery`, `page` or `sort` moves (the fetch effect's own key, round 3) and in the reset |

## Pins and ablations, round 1 (R1–R2, R4–R6)

Base leg (untouched `25c7d584e4`, pins written first), one locked run: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, `Tests 13 failed | 9 passed (22)` over the two round-1 pins plus the R3 probe; each red row failed on its intended assertion (quoted in the round-1 report on the card, `5855592309`). Fix leg at `5cd02243bb`: the two pins plus every sibling pin (`LineItemsPanel*` ×8, `recordFormsErrorClears-10682`, `supersededReads-10712`, `useRecordQuery.supersededAnswer-10712`, `useRecordQuery.test.ts`): `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 14 passed (14)`, `Tests 178 passed (178)` (with the 9-row hook pin, before its `reset()`-in-window control).

Ablations on committed `5cd02243bb`, each through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor declared to hit once; anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, then blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty), under a shell `trap` on EXIT INT TERM; panel legs over the R1–R2 pin plus `recordFormsErrorClears-10682` and `heldForAnotherParent-10740` (88 rows), hook legs over the R4–R6 pin plus `supersededAnswer-10712` (18 rows). No build is on the resolution path (the pins import `./index` / `./useRecordQuery` relatively and `@object-ui/react` resolves to `src` through the root vitest alias).

| leg | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | the rows-commit guard `if (!isCurrent()) return;` deleted | 2: 「values: a SUPERSEDED load that lands LAST」 and objectui#10682's 「a SUPERSEDED load that succeeds does not clear the failure the current load reported」 |
| A2 | `finally` releases `loading` unconditionally | 2: both loading rows |
| A3 | the save reloads regardless of `parentStillShown()` | 2: 「LANDS after the swap to p2」 and 「swap to p2 whose load FAILED」 |
| A4 | the save's failure written regardless of `parentStillShown()` | 1: 「FAILS after the swap to p2」 |
| A5 | the save reloads through the captured `load` | 1: 「reads the panel's CURRENT inputs」 |
| A6 | `runSeqRef.current += 1` deleted from `reset` | 4: `enabled`, `reset()`, `objectName`, `dataSource` |
| A7 | `setLoading(false)` deleted from `reset` | 4: the same four, on their loading assertion |
| A8 | the reset effect keyed on `enabled` again | 2: `objectName`, `dataSource` |
| A9 | the debounce cleanup keyed on unmount only | 1: 「a filter change inside the debounce window」 |
| A10 | `clearDebounce()` deleted from `reset` | 1: the `reset()`-in-window control |

## Pins and ablations, round 2 (R3)

`LineItemsPanel.dirtyReloadHold-10712.test.tsx`, 14 rows: for each of sort, limit and filter, a clean-change control (reloads with the change), the dirty row (no read, edits kept drawn and editable, Save on, no loading paragraph, no placeholder), and the post-save row (the reload after Save carries the changed input, exactly two `find` calls); plus five controls: a parent move while dirty is read and the held rows refused there (objectui#10740's shape), a swap back to the edited parent after a move is read (the last-run-parent clause), a change held while a same-parent read was in flight is replayed once on that read's commit (the fourth `find` carries `$top: 200`), a change of adapter is read, and a change of child object is read.

Base leg on the round-1 head `5cd02243bb` (the R3 pin, the edited 10740 pin and the edited R1–R2 pin, written before the source edit), one locked run: `VERDICT command-exit 1`, `Tests 9 failed | 24 passed (33)`. The red rows, each on its `find` count: the three dirty rows (「a same-parent reload ran over unsaved edits: called 1 times, but got 2 times」), the three post-save rows (1 expected, 2 before Save), the parent-move control (its pre-move hold assertion), the in-flight replay row (3 expected, 4), and the rewritten R2c row. Green on base: the three clean controls, the swap-back row, the adapter and child-object rows, and the re-judged 10740 row (its post-save trigger exercises the property at either source).

Fix leg at `bef026bdc5`, one locked run: the R3 pin, the R1–R2 pin, every sibling `LineItemsPanel*` pin (×8), `recordFormsErrorClears-10682` and `supersededReads-10712`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 12 passed (12)`, `Tests 165 passed (165)`.

Ablations on committed `bef026bdc5` (panel blob `bbeb098240f7`), each through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor declared to hit once; 「ok mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0」 with the blob change, then 「blob after restore」 == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean before and after), under a shell `trap` on EXIT INT TERM, over the R3 pin, the 10740 pin and the R1–R2 pin (33 rows). Three legs (H2, H3, H7) were first spelled with a replacement that was a substring of its own anchor; the tool refused them as no-ops (「the replacement count moved N to N, a rise of 0」), nothing was written (restore proven), and they re-ran with a unique replacement token, readings below.

| leg | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| H1 | the hold condition neutralised (`if (false && …)`) | 9: the three dirty rows, the three post-save rows, the parent-move control's pre-move assertion, the in-flight replay row, and the rewritten R2c row |
| H2 | the last-run-parent clause dropped | 3: 「a swap BACK to the edited parent after a move is read」, 10740's 「a swap BACK to p1 whose load fails again」, and the in-flight replay row (the swap back is held) |
| H3 | the adapter / child-object / relationship-field identity clauses dropped | 2: 「a change of ADAPTER while dirty is read」, 「a change of CHILD OBJECT while dirty is read」 |
| H4 | the `dirty` clause dropped | 4: the three clean-change controls (a clean change is held), and the in-flight replay row (the replay is held) |
| H5 | the `rowsHeldFor` equals `parentId` clause dropped | 1: 10740's 「after a refused state, a load for the CURRENT parent that commits takes the grid back」 (the held rows are another parent's, and the reload for the current one is held) |
| H6 | the replay on commit deleted | 1: the in-flight replay row |
| H7 | a run no longer clears the pending flag | 4: the three post-save rows and the rewritten R2c row (an extra replay read after the post-save reload) |
| H8 | the post-save reload marked `'inputs'` (so it can be held) | 6: the re-judged 10740 row, the R1–R2 control 「a save whose parent is still on screen reloads it」, the three post-save rows, and the rewritten R2c row |

## Pins and ablations, round 3 (the R6 sibling)

Two rows added to `useRecordQuery.cannotQuery-10712.test.tsx`: 「a sort change inside the debounce window: the fetch effect carries the typed term with the new sort, and the armed timer runs no older query」 (`setSearch('a')`, `toggleSort('name')`; the second `find` carries `$orderby name asc` and `$search a`; the window is outwaited; exactly two `find` calls; the answer commits with `sort` reading `name asc`) and 「a page change inside the debounce window (paginate): the fetch effect carries the typed term on the new page, and the armed timer runs no older query」 (`pageSize 10`, `setSearch('a')`, `setPage(2)`; the second `find` carries `$skip 10` and `$search a`; exactly two calls; `page` reads 2).

One locked chain at `ad6629e704` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`, each leg's exit read from its own log; the hook swapped and restored by `git checkout`, restore proven by blob == HEAD `910e8d78a8e3` and `git diff HEAD` empty after every leg):

- **Base leg**: the hook at `bef026bdc5` (blob `d010cbf927c7`, the round-3 key spelled 0 times on disk, the round-2 key 1 time) under the three `useRecordQuery.*` pins: vitest exit 1, `Test Files 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, `Tests 2 failed | 28 passed (30)`. The red rows are exactly the two, each on its `find` count: 「the debounced timer ran the query it was armed with, without the sort: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 2 times, but got 3 times」 and 「the debounced timer ran the query it was armed with, for page 1: expected "vi.fn()" to be called 2 times, but got 3 times」.
- **Fix leg**: the three `useRecordQuery.*` pins plus the plugin-form panel set (`LineItemsPanel*` ×10, `recordFormsErrorClears-10682`, `supersededReads-10712`): vitest exit 0, `Test Files 15 passed (15)`, `Tests 195 passed (195)`.
- **Ablation A11**, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, anchor declared to hit once): the cleanup key back to `[runQuery, clearDebounce]`. 「ok mutation landed: anchor 1 to 0, blob 910e8d78a8e3 to e1a59b997873」 (the tool's arrows spelled as a word); over the three `useRecordQuery.*` pins: vitest exit 1, `Tests 2 failed | 28 passed (30)`, the red rows exactly the two round-3 rows; then 「blob after restore」 and 「blob at HEAD」 both `910e8d78a8e3`, 「git diff HEAD empty」.
- **StrictMode**, a throwaway `renderHook` probe under a `React.StrictMode` wrapper (deleted, never committed; readings written to a file), the term `a` armed and the change made inside the window, counting the `find` calls after the double-mounted initial reads: at `bef026bdc5` sort 2 (the second `$search a` without `$orderby`), page 2 (the second `$skip 0`), filter 1, plain `setSearch` 1; at `ad6629e704` sort 1, page 1, filter 1, plain 1, each carrying the term with the new sort, page or filter. A `setSearch('a')` from page 2 then `setSearch('ab')` reads the same at both heads: `a` at once through the fetch effect (the page moves to 1), then `ab` through the timer. StrictMode double-invokes effects on mount only, where no timer exists yet.

## Gates

At `5cd02243bb` (round 1): `pnpm turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/plugin-form^..." --filter="@object-ui/fields^..." --concurrency=2` exit 0, `Tasks: 11 successful, 11 total`; `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-form --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2` exit 0, `Tasks: 14 successful, 14 total`; the union `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/ packages/fields/` exit 0, `Test Files 346 passed | 1 skipped (347)`, `Tests 5000 passed | 8 skipped (5008)`; the round-1 light gates and the narrowed eslint (recorded in the round-1 report `5855592309`).

At `bef026bdc5` (round 2), one locked chain, each step's exit read from its own log: the round-2 ablations above (the tree restored, panel blob == HEAD `bbeb098240f7`, `git diff HEAD` empty, `git status` clean); `pnpm turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/plugin-form^..." --concurrency=2` exit 0, `Tasks: 11 successful, 11 total` (the recreated worktree had no `dist/`; the closure was rebuilt from turbo's cache, which the type-check then resolved against); `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/plugin-form --concurrency=2` exit 0, `Tasks: 13 successful, 13 total`, `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` echoed for `@object-ui/plugin-form`. The fields package was byte-identical to round 1 at that head.

At `ad6629e704` (round 3, the fields package only; plugin-form is byte-identical to `bef026bdc5`), one locked chain, each step's exit read from its own log, `VERDICT command-exit 0`: `pnpm turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/fields --concurrency=2` exit 0, `Tasks: 12 successful, 12 total`, with 「@object-ui/fields:type-check: cache miss, executing」 (run fresh, not replayed) and `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` echoed; `--listFilesOnly` puts the pin in the `tsconfig.test.json` program and the hook in the `tsconfig.json` program (1 hit each). The fields package suite, `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/fields/`: exit 0, `Test Files 213 passed | 1 skipped (214)`, `Tests 3439 passed | 7 skipped (3446)` (the hook's three callers, `LookupField`, the people picker and `RecordPickerDialog`, live there).

Light gates at `bef026bdc5` and again at `ad6629e704`, each exit 0 at both heads: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`VERDICT new-cross-file-line-citations: 0 new citation(s)`), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:published-tsconfig-exclude`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `lint:coverage`, `type-check:coverage`, `check:changeset-claims` (「No pending changeset names a file this change touches」), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-presence` (「6 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)」), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-changeset-fixed`; `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 8 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

eslint at `bef026bdc5`, narrowed to the panel and its three pins (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): exit 0, 4 files, 0 errors. `LineItemsPanel.tsx` carries 18 warnings with the same rule multiset as its base blob (14 `no-explicit-any`, 2 `set-state-in-effect`, 2 `exhaustive-deps`; the two `set-state-in-effect` sites and the two `exhaustive-deps` sites are the base's own). The pins carry only `no-explicit-any` (14, 12, 10). eslint at `ad6629e704`, narrowed to the hook and its R4–R6 pin: exit 0, 2 files, 0 errors; `useRecordQuery.ts` carries 8 warnings with the same rule multiset and the same four non-`any` sites as its base blob linted through `--stdin --stdin-filename` (4 `no-explicit-any`, 2 `exhaustive-deps` at `runQuery` and the fetch effect, 2 `set-state-in-effect` at the fetch and reset effects; the debounce cleanup's new key draws none), and the pin carries 8 `no-explicit-any`. The narrowing evidence is the round-1 one: the population is `eslint.config.js`'s `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`, `--print-config` shows `parserOptions: {}` and no `project` / `projectService`, so no rule is type-aware and this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict.

NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: the repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the rest of the lint and test farm.

## Serial
